free_tier.stated: No permanent free storage: anonymous 100 GB upload / 24h per visitor token (500 GB / 24h per IP), free-account token = unlimited upload bandwidth and no daily file cap, but every free file expires in 3-7 days; permanent storage starts at $5/mo for 100 GB

retention.stated: No permanent free storage: anonymous 100 GB upload / 24h per visitor token (500 GB / 24h per IP), free-account token = unlimited upload bandwidth and no daily file cap, but every free file expires in 3-7 days; permanent storage starts at $5/mo for 100 GB

egress.terms: Downloads 'unlimited and unthrottled'. This is the most generous free egress found in the niche, it just cannot hold data.

record.tooling: documented 33-endpoint REST API (init -> presigned PUT -> confirm), presigned URLs point at r2.cloudflarestorage.com; CLI + desktop app + ShareX; no rclone
record.chaining: The upload quota is per visitor token AND per IP, so 100 GB/24h x N tokens (up to the 500 GB/IP ceiling) x N IPs. A throughput engine rather than a store; pairs well as the write side in front of a permanent store.
record.limits_note: 25 GB/file (100 GB paid); 100 GB/24h per visitor token, 500 GB/24h per IP; 50 files/24h anonymous; expiry 3 days default, 7 max; 60-500 req/min per endpoint
record.reliability_note: objects live on Cloudflare R2 behind presigned URLs and are garbage-collected at expiry; anonymous files need the returned owner_token to mutate anything and it cannot be recovered

evidence.proved: 'No token: 100 GB / 24 hours (500 GB per IP), files expire after 3 days'; 'Free account token: Unlimited upload bandwidth, no daily file cap'; 'downloads are unlimited and unthrottled'
permanence is paid: Personal $5/mo 100 GB, 'Files never expire'
